Bash & Shell Scripting

Essential Bash commands, syntax patterns, parameter expansions, flow controls, and shell script templates.

Docs

Variables & Special Parameters

Variables
#
VAR="value"  # No spaces around =

Assign string to variable

echo "$VAR" or "${VAR}"

Dereference variable safely with double quotes

$0

Name of the current script

$1, $2, ... $9

Positional arguments passed to script

$#

Total count of arguments supplied

$@

All arguments as separate quoted words ("$@")

$?

Exit status of the most recently executed command

$$

Process ID (PID) of current running shell

Parameter Expansion Tricks

Expansions
#
${VAR:-"default"}

If VAR unset/null, use "default" without assigning

${VAR:="default"}

If VAR unset/null, assign "default" to VAR

${VAR:?"error message"}

Exit script with message if VAR is unset

${#VAR}

Length of string stored in VAR

${VAR%pattern}

Remove shortest trailing match of pattern

${VAR#pattern}

Remove shortest leading match of pattern

${VAR//search/replace}

Replace all occurrences of search pattern

Conditionals & Loops

Control Flow
#
if [[ -f "$FILE" ]]; then
  echo "exists"
fi

Test if file exists and is regular file

if [[ -z "$VAR" ]]; then echo "empty"; fi

Test if string length is zero

for item in a b c; do echo "$item"; done

Iterate over explicit list items

for file in *.log; do echo "$file"; done

Glob pattern matching over files

while IFS= read -r line; do ...; done < file.txt

Read file line-by-line safely

Pipes, Redirection & I/O

I/O
#
cmd > file.txt

Redirect stdout to file (overwrite)

cmd >> file.txt

Append stdout to end of file

cmd 2> error.log

Redirect stderr to file

cmd &> all_output.log

Redirect both stdout and stderr to file

cmd1 | cmd2

Pipe stdout of cmd1 into stdin of cmd2

cmd > /dev/null 2>&1

Silence all stdout and stderr completely

Production Bash Script Skeleton

Best Practice
#
Strict mode bash script header
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -Eeuo pipefail
trap 'echo "Error on line $LINENO" >&2' ERR

readonly SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
readonly APP_ENV="${APP_ENV:-development}"

main() {
    echo "Running in $APP_ENV mode from $SCRIPT_DIR"
}

main "$@"
